company.shortDescription: Excyton develops novel light emitting materials and devices based on perovskite materials for application in displays.
company.description: Excyton develops Perovskite LEDs for next-generation displays. The portfolio of patents includes formulations for perovskite ink, device architectures, production processes, and display designs. The company generates innovative designs to improve the effectiveness, vibrancy, brightness, and clarity of displays.

The abstract details a display with sub-pixels configured to emit red and green light at specific visible spectrum wavelengths, aligning with Excyton’s focus on novel light emitting materials and devices for display applications. This work highlights Excyton’s efforts in advancing light emission architectures for display technologies.
